fact: The head of Northern State's technical committee for the Esali electronic payment project said the project was 95 per cent implemented in the state, the committee supplying devices, training and networks under the state Ministry of Finance; the system was activated first in the state headquarters units, and activation in the localities is the third of four phases.
title: الشمالية تقترب من التشغيل الكامل لـ«إيصالي» بعد إنجاز 95% من مشروع السداد الإلكتروني
